---
name: found-district
description: Found a new district (Mayor delegates to the City Planner, Building Inspector, and Treasurer)
argument-hint: District name and vibe, e.g. Noodle Heights, built on a retired noodle factory
agent: mayor
---

The citizens of Agentic City petition the council to found a new district. Use the name and vibe given after the slash command. If none was given, invent something delightful that fits the city.

Run your full procedure: record the decision in the council minutes, have the City Planner design the district and update the map, have the Building Inspector inspect it, and have the Treasurer pay for it if it was not denied. Finish with the outcome and suggest the Town Crier handoff.
